assumptions.statement: Every unit is behavior-preserving: current observable outputs are the regression baseline.

risks.statement: SQL drift or atomicity loss when write SQL is relocated into the write-repository (UNIT-002).
risks.mitigation: Statement-byte-identical relocation first (same SQL text, params, transaction grouping); TEST_PROPOSAL write-parity across the 5 leaked tables.

risks.statement: Optimistic-update / rollback corruption when row-mutation orchestration is rehomed (UNIT-003, UNIT-004).
risks.mitigation: Isolate optimistic+dirty+rollback into the new module; cross-seam behavior test proposed; move as one slice, no half-move.

risks.statement: Generation-tracking rollback race duplicated across two UIs drifts during hoist (UNIT-007).
risks.mitigation: Move generation rollback as one indivisible unit with its mutation; preserve the 31-ref contract verbatim; TEST_PROPOSAL.

risks.statement: Ownership bypass if the last-owner invariant's four encodings diverge (UNIT-008).
risks.mitigation: One SQL predicate + one TS guard behind one function (DEC-009); both remove and update reject last-owner loss; 6 existing tests green.

risks.statement: A 'use server' file exports a non-async function; only next build catches it (UNIT-002, 003, 007).
risks.mitigation: Run next build before claiming these units done; tsc/vitest miss it.

risks.statement: Selector/context seam regresses render perf; deleting comparators before the cause (UNIT-005).
risks.mitigation: Selector/context seam not a smaller prop list (DEC-006); stabilize handler identity (UNIT-003) before deleting comparators; render-probe baseline + guard.

risks.statement: Phase-2/3 shared-file collision on the estimate sheet (UNIT-003/004/005).
risks.mitigation: Disjoint files where possible; LOOP_LEDGER first-writer-wins on any collision (DEC-004).

risks.statement: Dead-seam / setter deletion order strands a dangling import (UNIT-001, UNIT-006).
risks.mitigation: Delete callers before symbols; re-grep zero-caller symbols immediately before delete.

risks.statement: Contract test asserts comparator anchor strings, not behavior — false confidence (UNIT-005).
risks.mitigation: Replace the anchor-string assertion with a behavior assertion at the seam.

risks.statement: Adapter collapse drops or mis-maps a snapshot field (UNIT-009).
risks.mitigation: Behavior-preserving bar = identical overview snapshot output; admin-only surface.

risks.statement: Audit-time-dead symbols gain a caller before execution (UNIT-001, UNIT-014).
risks.mitigation: Re-grep zero-caller/zero-importer symbols immediately before delete; audit-time dead != merge-time dead.

decisions.statement: Plan pack warranted: high-blast-radius, codebase-wide architecture refactor.
Default test_requirement NOT_REQUIRED; TEST_PROPOSAL recorded (not executed) for high-blast units.
Deletion over compatibility (alpha/pre-beta) for dead seams and pass-through reducers.
One writer per shared file; disjoint-file units parallelize; LOOP_LEDGER first-writer-wins on collision.
Read-side (UNIT-001) precedes write-side (UNIT-002) so the action/repository layering is legible first.
UNIT-005 seam is selector/context, not a smaller prop list.
Keep the logic-encoding componentLibrarySheetReducer; delete only pass-through reducers.
Behavior-preserving bar: observable outputs unchanged; tsc + next build clean (build is a surface, not a gate, unless authorized).
UNIT-008 target: one SQL predicate + one TS guard behind one function.
